# Architecture 
This is a KotlinMultiplatform App sharing UI with Jetpack Compose. 
The defined architecture for this project is MVVM + UDF and Clean Architecture. 
Keep Logic in the Composables UI as small as possible.

# Local pre-PR checks

Run `./scripts/pre-pr.sh` after making code changes and before creating a pull request. Use its exit status to verify the local checks and report any test failures or environment limitations that prevented a complete run.
